organization: Above and Beyond Family Recovery Center
program: Free outpatient addiction counseling and recovery support

acceptance.evidence: Independent GPT-6 Astra Medium acceptance audit, 2026-09-29: original financial statements, service geography, clinical-source interpretation and model arithmetic checked. Accepted only as an explicitly judgment-driven alpha scenario, not measured marginal effectiveness.

what: Above and Beyond offers free outpatient addiction counseling on Chicago's West Side.
The model credits only a short health-utility improvement from additional treatment.
The central model uses $4,296,413 of whole-recipient audited expense.
strengths: Annual participation and recovery claim are published.
Free walk-in access can remove affordability barriers.
reservations: Recovery has no clear denominator or follow-up.
Gifts may replace fees, trustees or other donors.

sections.what: Free Level I/II outpatient counseling and referral operate at 2942 W Lake Street, Chicago (Cook County, current MSA). Medical linkage is not evidence of universal medication treatment. Pantry is a sister organization. [Protocol](https://aboveandbeyondfrc.org/how-we-do-it/clinical-protocol/)
sections.monitoring: 2023 snapshot reports 1,058 group participants and 42.9% recovered, without definition or denominator. Applying that rate to group participants is judgment; validity factor 0.5 reduces it but cannot validate the unknown denominator. Project MATCH compared active alcohol therapies, not treatment versus none; it does not supply this recipient's causal effect. Request validated utility, retention and counterfactual recovery. [Snapshot](https://aboveandbeyondfrc.org/donate/annual-report/) [Original trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8979210/)
sections.qualitative: Walk-in trauma-informed counseling provides plausible access. Housing, employment and medical linkage receive no separate health credit to avoid overlap. No mortality benefit or lifelong remission is assumed. [Programs](https://aboveandbeyondfrc.org/donate/annual-report/)
sections.cost: Use all $4,296,413 audited 2024 expenses, not the $3,526,474 tax summary. Includes $572,432 recognized donated resources and gross event costs. A $1,000 whole-portfolio equivalent corresponds to 0.246 group participants before response/additionality/geography, not actual marginal admission cost. Six-month utility gain is judged, no survival effect. [Original audit](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/display_audit/2024-12-GSAFAC-0000386319) The audit separately nets a $50,786 loss on transfer of assets against revenue. It is outside the operating-expense numerator; including it as a broader accounting-cost sensitivity gives $4,347,199. This is not an omitted recurring treatment cost.
sections.funding: 2024 original audit: support/revenue $5,078,619; program expense $3,231,072, management $756,564, fundraising $308,777; net assets $2,355,942; cash $1,892,947. Program fees $2,390,278, deferred grant $585,104 and note payable $850,000 complicate liquidity. Gift is unrestricted portfolio support; 30% financing additionality discounts fee/trustee/donor replacement. Marketing that operating costs are covered does not establish zero overhead or entirely additional health. [Audit](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/display_audit/2024-12-GSAFAC-0000386319) [Giving](https://aboveandbeyondfrc.org/donate/)

model.costScope: All audited expenses including recognized in-kind, support and events; no sister pantry benefit. A $50,786 loss on transfer of assets appears separately in revenue and is excluded from operating expense; broader accounting-cost sensitivity disclosed.
model.geographicAttribution: Chicago Cook County site; g=.95 judged, not observed residence.
model.counterfactual: Other care/spontaneous recovery removed by a; replacement financing separately removed by b.
model.attribution: Only short incremental morbidity; no all-recovery, employment, housing or mortality credit.
model.uncertainty: Very weak clinical attribution; current volume and response definition unknown. The central estimate is an illustrative scenario, not a calibrated expected value; favorable/poor scenarios are not statistical confidence bounds. Service location establishes eligibility, while modeled MSA residency shares remain unmeasured.
model.nativeOutcomes: Incremental response equivalents, .10 utility for .5 years central.

inputs.name: N
inputs.rationale: 2023 count carried forward as explicit scale assumption.

inputs.name: p
inputs.rationale: Organization-reported 2023 recovery percentage with undefined recovery criterion and denominator; not participant self-report, a measured group-participant response rate, or a causal estimate.

inputs.name: a
inputs.unit: response share additional to alternative care
inputs.rationale: 30% excludes other care and spontaneous recovery.

inputs.name: u
inputs.rationale: Illustrative .10 health utility, no measured EQ-5D.

inputs.name: T
inputs.rationale: Six-month cap incorporates relapse, no mortality.

sensitivity: Zero additional response means zero health.
Duration .25 to1 year changes health fourfold.

Cross-organization outcomes are not additive: the same person may receive services from several organizations. Alternative-service factors are judgments and do not establish deduplication across this edition.
